title: Article: Why Do People Perform Parikrama (Circumambulation)?

segments.text: Occult science (Spiritual science) deals with hidden spiritual forces, both divine and negative. This blog explains how it works with examples of two devotees of Lord Hanuman Ji Maharaj

When a devotee performs parikrama around a sacred fire (hawan kund) while chanting mantra, a powerful process takes place. The mantra create an energy seal around the hawan kund portal (a spiritual gateway). When a deity arrives through that portal, they must unlock the mantra sealed using their energy. This energy is then returned to the devotee as a blessing.

However, if someone performs parikrama without a Guru’s consecrated mantra, the portal remains unsealed, and no energy exchange takes place. This means the parikrama will not have the same spiritual benefits.
Bhaiya Ji’s Experience with Parikrama and Hawan

Bhaiya Ji shared an unique experience from his spiritual journey. He had a ritual of visiting his Kuldevta temple on his birthday, but he couldn’t go to the main temple and instead visited a nearby temple. There, he with the help of drishti, he saw many deities performing parikrama around the temple.

Later, during the establishment of Ashaeiynn, Bhaiya Ji learned from Gurudev about the power of Mahayagya (a grand fire ceremony). When the Mahayagya was performed continuously for 15 days, he saw with drishti that 16-18 lakh saints joined the ritual and shared divine knowledge with him.

During these rituals, Bhaiya Ji observed that the sacred fire in the hawan kund acted as a portal connected to different dimensions. The more the fire burned, the stronger the connection with the universe became. Over time, these connections formed bonds with deities from other loks. One fascinating moment was when bhaiya ji saw an army of Gurudev’s disciples, carrying flags, going to another dimension to help a deity in a spiritual battle. This was possible because of the strong bond created through the hawan.

Major temples like Tirupati Balaji and Shri Jagannath Temple have continuously open divine portals inside their sanctum (Garbha Graha). Deities and spiritual energies from other dimensions frequently visit these places. If a devotee regularly seals the portal with mantras while performing parikrama, the arriving deities become bound by the mantra and must release their energy to the devotee. This is why sacred chanting and parikrama hold immense power in temples.
